sources.title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
sources.summary: Origin paper of Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), DeepSeek's KV-cache-compressing attention that became the foundation of its long-context economics and was widely copied across Chinese and Western labs.
key_facts: DeepSeek-V2 (236B total / 21B activated, 128K context) introduced Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), May 2024; https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434
Paper reports MLA-based V2 cuts KV cache 93.3% and boosts max generation throughput 5.76x vs DeepSeek 67B; https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434

sources.title: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
sources.summary: DeepSeek's NSA paper (Feb 2025): sparse attention that is trainable end-to-end and aligned to GPU hardware, the research step between MLA and the production DSA/CSA lines.
key_facts: NSA (Native Sparse Attention) posted 2025-02-16 by DeepSeek — hardware-aligned, natively trainable sparse attention for long context; https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.11089

sources.title: Introducing DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp (DeepSeek API news, 2025-09-29)
sources.summary: Official release note for DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp introducing DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production, with an immediate API price cut of over 50% — the moment sparse attention became a pricing weapon.
key_facts: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp (built on V3.1-Terminus) introduced DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), released 2025-09-29; https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news250929
DeepSeek API prices dropped 50%+ effective immediately with V3.2-Exp launch (2025-09-29); https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news250929
V3.1-Terminus kept on temporary comparison API until 2025-10-15 15:59 UTC; https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news250929

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
sources.summary: DeepSeek-V4 technical report (Apr 2026): hybrid Compressed Sparse Attention + Heavily Compressed Attention makes 1M-token context routine at a fraction of V3.2's cost; two MoE sizes (Pro 1.6T, Flash 284B).
key_facts: DeepSeek-V4-Pro: 1.6T params (49B activated); DeepSeek-V4-Flash: 284B (13B activated); both 1M-token context; posted 2026-04-26; https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19348
V4 hybrid attention combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) + Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA), plus Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections and Muon optimizer; https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19348
At 1M-token context, V4-Pro needs only 27% of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache vs DeepSeek-V3.2; pre-trained on 32T+ tokens; https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19348

sources.title: Training-Free Long-Context Scaling of Large Language Models (Dual Chunk Attention)
sources.venue_or_author: arXiv / Chunqiu Steven Xia et al. (Alibaba-affiliated authors)
sources.summary: The Dual Chunk Attention (DCA) paper: training-free decomposition of attention into chunk-wise pieces that lets models serve contexts far beyond their training window; later productized in Qwen's 1M-token models.
key_facts: DCA (posted 2024-02-27) enables 100k+-token windows without training and underpins Qwen long-context serving; https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17463

sources.title: Qwen2.5-1M Technical Report
sources.summary: Alibaba's Qwen2.5-1M report (Jan 2025): open-weight 1M-token context models plus an open-sourced inference framework combining DCA and sparse attention for practical million-token serving.
key_facts: Qwen2.5-1M (posted 2025-01-26) brought open-weight 1M-token context with a DCA + sparse-attention serving stack; https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.15383

sources.title: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct model card
sources.summary: Model card for Qwen3-Next, Alibaba's hybrid linear-attention architecture: 3:1 Gated DeltaNet to Gated Attention layers with ultra-sparse MoE, native 262K context extending to ~1M via YaRN — China's flagship 'hybrid' answer to long-context cost.

sources.title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving

key_facts: Kimi K3: 2.8T-param MoE, 104B activated, native vision, 1M-token context; posted 2026-07-27; https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653

notes:
CHINA CONTEXT-MANAGEMENT STACK SWEEP (as of 2026-08-24). Caps: 18/18 search calls (gnews/gnews-zh/mojeek), 7/12 WebFetch, ~16 min. Google News redirector URLs could not be resolved to publisher URLs (new opaque encoding; curl and WebFetch both return the GN shell), so news facts from RSS are marked 'per headline' with the genuine redirector URL, per ground rules.

SHAPE OF THE STACK: (1) DeepSeek attention line: MLA (2024) -> NSA (Feb 2025) -> DSA in V3.2-Exp (Sep 29 2025, API -50%+) -> V4 (Apr 2026): CSA+HCA hybrid, 1M-token context at 27% FLOPs / 10% KV cache of V3.2; open weights with day-0 Huawei Ascend support (per InfoQ-CN headline). (2) Alibaba/Qwen: DCA (2024) -> Qwen2.5-1M (Jan 2025) -> Qwen3-Next hybrid (3:1 Gated DeltaNet:Gated Attention, 80B-A3B, 262K native/1M YaRN) -> Qwen3.8 family (Aug 2026: Qwen3.8-Max 'massive context' on Alibaba Cloud; 2.4T-A95B open MoE served on NVIDIA GB300 per NVIDIA blog headline 2026-08-12). Tongyi/Bailian memory-service specifics did NOT surface in this sweep (gap). (3) Moonshot/Kimi: MoBA (Feb 2025); Mooncake KV-serving became cross-industry infrastructure (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, LMDeploy, LMCache, NIXL; FAST'25 best paper; 6.4k stars); Kimi K3 (Jul 2026): 2.8T/104B-active open MoE, 1M ctx, Kimi Delta Attention + Attention Residuals, ~2.5x scaling efficiency vs K2. Yang Zhilin publicly framed strategy as token efficiency + long context + agent swarms (per 鞭牛士 headline 2026-03-18). (4) MiniMax: lightning (linear) attention line MiniMax-01 (456B, 4M-token claim, Jan 2025) -> M1 (first open large hybrid-attention reasoning model, 1M ctx, arXiv:2506.13585) -> M2 (priced ~8 RMB per 1M tokens, per 36Kr headline 2025-10-27) -> M3 (Jun 2026, open weights, 1M ctx, new sparse attention, claimed 15.6x long-context speedup per VentureBeat headline).
